title: German-Czech Fund for the Future: Grants for Study Stays of German and Czech Students in the Neighbour Countries
summary: Grants for German and Czech students in humanities and social sciences to conduct research or study for 1 to 2 semesters in the neighbour country.

degree_levels.notes: Undergraduates, graduates, and doctoral candidates in Bachelor's, Master's and PhD programmes.

subject_areas.notes: Humanities and social sciences (history, politics, social sciences, law, economics, linguistics, literature, cultural studies, philosophy, etc.)

institutions.notes: German and Czech higher education institutions.

nationality.notes: Aimed at German and Czech students living in and applying from their home countries (Germany or Czech Republic).

residence.notes: The grants are exclusively geared to candidates who study in their home countries and wish to spend 1 or 2 semesters in the neighbour country for study purposes.

mandatory.text: Studies in humanities or social sciences
Research project related to German-Czech topics
Study in home country and wish to spend 1 or 2 semesters in the neighbour country

exceptions.text: Sponsorship is not intended as a continuation grant
Not possible to simultaneously hold a grant by the Fund and another sponsorship

funding.description: Master's and PhD students receive 900 EUR per month; Bachelor's students 750 EUR. An additional one-off allowance of 900 EUR, respectively 650 EUR, can be granted for material expenses or travel costs.

application_rounds.notes: The application deadline is 31 January for the following academic year.

recurring_deadline_notes: The application deadline is 31 January for the following academic year.

steps.text: Please see all application forms and further information on the application procedure at https://www.zukunftsfonds.cz/projektforderung/stipendien/

sources.title: German-Czech Fund for the Future: Grants for Study Stays of German and Czech Students in the Neighbour Countries - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: Fund supports German and Czech students undertaking study stays in the neighbour country, which includes Czech students coming to Germany.
